schema: FMZ 2514 archived Pine v4 daily ratings and execution-date USD conversion

model.venue: Saved Binance USD-M BTCUSDT UTC dates, daily chart and hourly base. ETHUSDT uses the same dates and fixed archive parameters. Each 4h reference is constructed from four public 1h candles.
model.source: The v4 file used 20 v5 request names. They are normalized to the v4 security alias. Ten bare color values receive their v4 namespace. The 14 moving-average votes preserve the archived SMA helpers even for variables named EMA, Hull or VWMA. The RSI helper receives a provably integer input length and the disabled Ichimoku component remains zero.
model.signals: The documented default lower-timeframe request selects the final 4h candle confirmed during each UTC daily bar. A three-day fixture distinguishes that alignment from selecting the first child with lookahead. An independent reference matches all 10,450 votes, three rating lines and 418 chart bars.
model.execution: One base unit or a two-unit opposite-side market order to reverse the existing position. All orders settle at the next daily open and reconcile to the first public 1h opening price. Each archived USD account starts at 500. Coinbase USDT-USD closes are effective from the next UTC day. Realized price movement is converted using the exit-day effective FX. Each 0.075% fee is converted on its own execution date.
model.risk: The archived legacy declaration has no margin constraint, so orders continue with negative account equity. Daily and closed-trade equity both document drawdown. The results describe that historical simulator setup and do not establish a risk-qualified $500 trading plan.

coverage: Tested · Pine v4 4h composite rating and USD conversion

Saved BTC UTC dates and ETH cross-asset test. Complete official 1h and 4h timing, independently verified vote and USD ledgers, 112 closes, and two explicitly open remainders. Unconstrained archived margin permits negative equity.
